text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At last, the day of the Mile Championship. 
Today, not only Daiichi Ruby, but also 
Daitaku Helios is running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no doubt this race would be a 
tough one. Perhaps Yamanin Zephyr felt it 
too, as a distinct tension showed on her 
profile, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —It's time, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well then. I'm off, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Yamanin Zephyr's expression looked 
clear and serene, as if she were 
completely certain of something."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... Here they come! It's the runners 
for the Mile CS!

text_block_list.name: Helios's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Helios~~~~!! Show us that spirited 
breakaway of yours again today~~!!

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Milady Daiichi Rubyyyy! I've come to 
witness your gloryyyy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaahhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(...The whirlwind stirred up by the 
spectators.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyy-yoooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hype it up! Run from the front! Let's rock 
this, YEAH★★★~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (...Miss Helios's tempest.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I promise you a magnificent victory.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (...Miss Ruby's heavenly breeze.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Perhaps everything was the wind. Blowing 
across the land that unfolds before my 
eyes, each and every single breeze.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(They may rage and surge at times, 
blocking my path of wind, but...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(At the Sprinters Stakes, I realized. 
...As long as I can continue being a 
mighty wind.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(As long as I possess the fierce resolve 
to become the supreme wind that surpasses 
all.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Swirling winds, raging winds, celestial 
winds! Enveloping all, sweeping everything 
up, to become a tempest even fiercer—!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Let our souls burn, and let us go forth.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The resolve is firmly within my heart. If 
so... I cannot let this end as a mere 
gentle breeze.
